fact: Car 23 driven on track following a release in an unsafe condition.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 34.14 e) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 23 (Alexander Albon), team representative and reviewed in-car video evidence and team radio. The Stewards accepted Albon's explanation, which was supported by In-Car video, that while he knew something was wrong with the car, it did not look from his position to be a classic loose wheel, not captured by the wheel nut. He was shown the green light by the team to exit the pits, and the team did not call him as they did not know at the time that the wheel was loose. Rather, Albon heard a metallic scraping noise, reported that something was wrong and drove the car carefully to the pits. The Stewards agreed that this was accomplished in a safe and appropriate manner, without affecting any other competitor and that the driver did not drive the car knowing it to be in an unsafe condition. The Stewards take no further action.
